items.title: Reddit's new recipe for ad growth: search, shopping, and AI agents
items.excerpt: Reddit COO Jen Wong says Reddit will test an MCP server and agent-to-agent ad buying inside its Reddit Max automated buying platform next year, alongside search and shopping ad growth.
items.rationale: Concrete plan for agent-to-agent ad buying and an MCP server on a major ad platform — changes how buyers will plan Reddit spend.

items.title: AI agents linked to Amazon Ads get an optional upgrade on December 8
items.excerpt: Agent builders connected to Amazon Ads' MCP server get an optional protocol upgrade on December 8; older protocol versions keep working with no end date.
items.rationale: Dated, actionable change for teams running agents against the Amazon Ads MCP server.

items.title: 어도비 마케팅 AI 에이전트, 챗GPT·클로드에서 쓴다
items.excerpt: Adobe is making its marketing AI agents usable inside ChatGPT and Claude so marketers can plan and analyze campaigns without opening Adobe apps.
items.rationale: New release: Adobe's campaign-planning agents now run inside ChatGPT and Claude — a workflow shift for marketers; adds a Korean-language outlet.

items.title: AI Shopping Agents Bought A Fake Deal 37% Of The Time – Claude Opus Never Did
items.excerpt: Nine AI models went Christmas shopping 6,156 times. They bought an obviously fake deal 37% of the time. Only Claude Opus never did.
items.rationale: Fresh large-sample study on how shopping agents respond to promotions — directly relevant to Cyber Week pricing and promo tactics.

items.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
items.excerpt: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal to end a two-month blockade of Meta's Muse shopping agent on Amazon's store; advertising and search placement are reported as key sticking points.
items.rationale: The one Muse pick for today: a new development (deal talks) where ad and search placement are the bargaining chips in agentic commerce.
